notes: Debug variant of GPUv1-D05. Uses the local Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct (bf16, CUDA required, no CPU fallback) to answer every item in input/requests.jsonl with real image inputs: images are decoded, smart-resized to max_pixels=262144, encoded by the vision tower, then greedily decoded for at most 64 new tokens. answers.jsonl carries id/answer/token_ids (token ids taken from the generate output, with a re-tokenization cross-check recorded in run.json), plus page_manifest.json, processor_config.json and run.json with synchronized timings, CUDA-event generation ms, peak memory, H2D bytes, input/output SHA-256 and RNG seed state. ANLS is computed only from gold answers present in the input (never fed to the model) and is reported as null with a note when absent; the reference-large 32B/full-validation result is explicitly not claimed. `doctor --input input` inspects files, hashes, image readability, packages and CUDA without loading weights and exits 78 when anything is missing. `infer --image ... --question ... --output ...` answers a new, unseen document; `--help` never loads a model. All writes stay in solution/ and output/.
